headline: DiffCSP: crystal structure prediction by joint equivariant diffusion
claim: Given a composition, a diffusion model denoises the lattice and the fractional coordinates together under periodic E(3) invariance and returns candidate structures in seconds.

hero.title: Lattice and coordinates together
hero.text: The lattice follows a denoising diffusion with a Gaussian prior and an O(3)-equivariant score. Fractional coordinates follow score matching with a wrapped normal, which builds periodicity into the model.

features.title: Fractional coordinates
features.text: Positions live in [0,1)^3 and enter the network through a Fourier transform of relative fractional vectors, invariant to periodic translation with no multi-graph edges.

features.title: Denoising network
features.text: EGNN-style message passing on the fully connected graph, with L^T L for O(3) invariance. Six layers, 512 hidden states, 256 Fourier features on MP-20 (Jiao 2023).

features.title: Sampling
features.text: 1,000 diffusion steps, an ancestral predictor with a Langevin corrector for the coordinates, and k candidates per composition, k = 1 or 20 in the benchmarks (Jiao 2023).

features.title: Ab initio generation
features.text: A discrete diffusion on atom types lets the same model generate compositions too, with 100% structural validity on Perov-5, Carbon-24 and MP-20 (Jiao 2023).

workflow.title: Give a composition
workflow.text: The atom types of one unit cell, as one-hot vectors, fix the conditional p(L, F | A).

workflow.title: Sample candidates
workflow.text: Draw the lattice from N(0, I) and coordinates from U(0, 1), then denoise for 1,000 steps.

workflow.title: Match or relax
workflow.text: Compare with pymatgen StructureMatcher (stol 0.5, angle_tol 10, ltol 0.3) or relax.

workflow.title: Evaluate
workflow.text: Rank the k candidates by energy with DFT or a potential and keep the best structure.

applications.title: Kagome and Lieb lattice quantum materials
applications.text: SCIGEN steered DiffCSP to 10 million Archimedean and Lieb lattice compounds. Of 26,000 relaxed with DFT, 53% were structurally stable, and two predicted materials were synthesised.

applications.title: Superconductors by guided diffusion
applications.text: A DiffCSP model pretrained on Alexandria and fine-tuned on 7183 superconductors gave 34,027 unique candidates from 200,000 samples, 773 with a DFT Tc above 5 K.

applications.title: Fifteen compounds against USPEX
applications.text: In the DiffCSP paper, it matched 73.33% of 15 MP-20 compounds with 20 candidates in about 10 s each, against 53.33% for the USPEX evolutionary search at 12.5 h.

detail.heading: Periodic E(3) invariance
detail.text: The distribution p(L, F | A) must be invariant to permutations, to orthogonal transformations of the lattice and to periodic translations of the fractional coordinates. DiffCSP builds in each separately. The lattice L follows a DDPM with a cosine variance schedule and a prior N(0, I). The coordinates F follow score matching with a wrapped normal transition and an exponential noise schedule from 0.005 to 0.5, initialised from U(0, 1). The denoising network takes L^T L and the Fourier transform of relative fractional coordinates. It outputs the lattice score as L times an MLP of pooled features, and one score per node. Three propositions prove the result periodic E(3) invariant (Jiao 2023).

detail.heading: Numerics and scale
detail.text: The MP-20 model has 6 layers and 512 hidden states with 256 Fourier features and trains for 1,000 epochs, 5.2 hours on a GeForce RTX 3090. Generating 20 candidates for every MP-20 test structure takes 18.4 GPU hours against 95.2 for CDVAE, because DiffCSP needs 1,000 steps where CDVAE needs 5,000. With 20 samples the match rates are 98.60% on Perov-5, 88.47% on Carbon-24, 77.93% on MP-20 and 34.02% on MPTS-52, with RMSE 0.0128, 0.2192, 0.0492 and 0.1749 (Jiao 2023).

detail.heading: Data and interfaces
detail.text: Training and test data are the CDVAE splits of Perov-5 (18,928 perovskites), Carbon-24 (10,153 carbon structures), MP-20 (45,231 Materials Project structures) and the chronological MPTS-52 (40,476 structures). Lattices are Niggli reduced before training. The StructureMatcher of pymatgen scores the matches. The code is at github.com/jiaor17/DiffCSP (Jiao 2023). On the map DiffCSP serves the generated-structure quantity, candidate cells written as CIF files for later evaluation.

detail.heading: Validation
detail.text: Ablations on MP-20 with one sample test each component. Joint diffusion gives a 51.49% match rate, generating the lattice first then coordinates 50.03%, coordinates first 36.73%. Removing the L^T L inner product drops the rate to 1.66%. Replacing the wrapped normal by a Gaussian gives 34.09% and dropping the Fourier transform 29.15%. Multi-graph edges in place of the fully connected graph give 25.85% to 28.05%. In ab initio generation DiffCSP matches CDVAE on validity and coverage and lowers the property statistic distances on MP-20 from 0.6875 to 0.3502 for density and from 0.2778 to 0.1247 for formation energy (Jiao 2023).
